fullSuite.limitation: This diagnostic full run began before the final UI labels, face-down exile checkpoint fix and exile-attribution refinements and Slinn Voda kicker correction. Two inventory checks failed against old expectations; both complete corrected files are included in the final affected run. The player-facing sweep found only the Slinn Voda kicker defect, whose fix is verified in paid human/AI tests and the same question inspector rerun for all 42 new cards. Do not describe this as a fully passing complete-suite run for the final tree.
